title: Tarot: Witch of the Black Rose — Meaning, Genes, And Nothing Else #Shorts
description:
The bleak reading of Tarot: Witch of the Black Rose is also the most testable one. Tarot: Witch of the Black Rose is an American comic book, written and drawn by Jim Balent with coloring and lettering by Holly Golightly and published by BroadSword Comics since 2000. The comic generally features fantasy, horror, action, and adventure interspersed with frequent scenes of nudity.

The story Tarot: Witch of the Black Rose tells about itself is the last thing to be trusted. Although both women survived, Tarot has apparently lost the ability to have children as a result of Azure's curse. Once she has recovered, Tarot sneaks into Azure's prison and confronts him, learning that it was he who told the Dragon Witches about Raven's gathering, and he who sent the lich that beat Jon nearly to death.
